summary: Completed comprehensive testing of TruckShield MVP. Backend APIs fully functional (100% pass rate). Frontend core journeys working with minor session persistence issue on direct URL access.

ui_bugs.issue: Session token not persisting when directly accessing protected routes via URL (e.g., /trips/:id). User gets redirected to login page.
ui_bugs.workaround: Navigate through the app UI instead of direct URL access

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix session persistence issue: When users directly access protected routes via URL (e.g., /trips/:id), the auth token is not being read from localStorage/sessionStorage correctly, causing redirect to login. Check AuthContext.js and ProtectedRoute.js to ensure token is loaded on initial mount before checking authentication status. This is a minor issue as navigation through the UI works correctly.
